bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for cultural upgrades at Battle Creek Recreation Center.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; CULTURAL UPGRADES AT BATTLE CREEK RECREATION CENTER. +]

[+$500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Humanities Center for a grant to Ramsey County to improve fields at Battle Creek Recreation Center to accommodate cultural diversity. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for cultural upgrades at Battle Creek Recreation Center.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; CULTURAL UPGRADES AT BATTLE CREEK RECREATION CENTER.

$500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Humanities Center for a grant to Ramsey County to improve fields at Battle Creek Recreation Center to accommodate cultural diversity.
